Nothing changed since the last run, so I stopped without making any game changes or shipping anything.

**What's blocking it:** step 1 (measure, then decide go or stop) still has only the "before" numbers. In today's setup both windows share one process. When player 1's window is busy for 2 seconds, player 2's window freezes for about 2010 ms.

The "after" half is still missing: whether the windows get separate processes, and player 2's freeze during that 2-second stall with the split. It has to be measured from outside the page, with `measure95.mjs` or `run-measure95.ps1` in the codex folder. My allowed commands can't run either one. `tools/handoff/console/notes/95/` still doesn't exist, and the codex measurements folder has only the "before" file.

alarms.md already asks the coordinator to run that measurement, so I didn't add another alarm. I added a short entry to `notes/95-p2-own-process.md`. Once the split numbers are in `notes/95/`, the next run can decide and build steps 2 to 7 behind an experimental switch that is off by default.

TASK PARTIAL: step 1 has no go decision because the split measurement (separate processes, player 2 freeze under 50 ms) has never been run; the coordinator needs to run run-measure95.ps1 and put the raw files in notes/95/, then steps 2 to 7 can be built and shipped.
